new_description:
Description

The ANEST IWATA W-71-1G Small Size Spray Gun Dia. 1.0Mm Gravity Type is designed for precision and efficiency in your spray painting projects. Its compact size makes it ideal for detailed work where control and accuracy are paramount. Whether you are working on automotive parts, furniture, or fine crafts, this spray gun offers consistent performance.

Equipped with a 1.0mm nozzle, this gravity feed spray gun ensures smooth and even paint application, reducing overspray and waste. The robust construction guarantees durability and long-lasting use, making it a reliable tool for both professionals and hobbyists. Its ergonomic design provides comfort during extended use, enhancing productivity and results.

Details

• Product Material: Metal

• Manufacturer: Anest Iwata

Features

  • Compact small size suitable for detailed spray work
  • 1.0mm nozzle diameter for precise paint application
  • Gravity feed design for efficient paint use and easy cleaning
  • Durable metal construction ensures long-term reliability
  • Ergonomic design for comfortable handling during use

How to use

Before using the spray gun, ensure it is properly assembled and connected to the air supply. Fill the gravity cup with the desired paint and adjust the air pressure and nozzle settings according to the paint manufacturer's recommendations. Hold the spray gun at a consistent distance from the surface, typically 6 to 8 inches, and apply even strokes to achieve a smooth finish. After use, clean the spray gun thoroughly to prevent paint buildup and maintain optimal performance.

Care instructions

Clean the spray gun immediately after use by flushing it with an appropriate cleaning solvent to remove all paint residues. Disassemble the nozzle and needle components periodically for deep cleaning. Store the spray gun in a dry place to prevent rust or corrosion. Avoid exposing the tool to extreme temperatures or harsh chemicals to maintain its longevity.
